programs.floorNote: Statement credit against travel and dining purchases (Travel Rewards), or any purchase on Premium Rewards cards: 1¢ a point (statement credit), the best fixed rate any holder can get in OCCB.

programs.name: Capital One Miles
programs.floorNote: Purchase Eraser, against travel purchases charged in the last 90 days: 1¢ a point (statement credit), the best fixed rate any holder can get in OCCB.

programs.name: Cash back
programs.floorNote: 1 point = 1 cent, as a statement credit or deposit. Covers: American Express Reward Dollars, Apple Daily Cash, Bank of America cash rewards, Capital One cash rewards, Amazon rewards points, Costco annual reward (Citi), Discover Cashback Bonus, U.S. Bank cash rewards.

programs.name: Citi ThankYou Points
programs.floorNote: Citi Travel bookings at 1¢ for every ThankYou card: 1¢ a point (portal), the best fixed rate any holder can get in OCCB.

programs.name: City National Rewards Points
programs.floorNote: Airfare with no blackout dates through the rewards site or Award Headquarters. Reported values were 1.2¢ online and 1.1¢ through the concierge after an October 2019 devaluation, with a booking fee lowering the effective value; no current figure is published, so these are dated estimates: 1¢ a point…
